findings.detail: quant_io_foundation_release_guard() (src/postgres/quant-io-runtime-schema.sql:32) reads quant_io_launches and quant_io_ledgers unqualified without a pinned search_path; an independent probe released a RUNNING job with an unresolved launch by shadowing both tables with empty temporary tables.
check_bot_parent() (src/postgres/schema.sql:124) reads users unqualified; a temporary users table let a child of a non-top-level bot be inserted.
The runtime role holds TEMP through PUBLIC; revoking TEMP would close every shadow of this class but is a grant change requiring an owner decision and a staging window.

limits: Throwaway local PostgreSQL only; not committed, deployed or applied anywhere.
